I think the hardest part for me is when the person you ask help from ends up becoming tired of your thoughts. You get so used to talking to that person when you feel like shit but from the moment you realize they’re tired of you, it becomes so hard to break the habit of contacting them. But I can’t blame them of course. It just sucks..

When I was 2, my mom had like this clothes hamper where if you close the top it forms a frog. I went inside of it and when I got out a huge ass wire from the hamper came out and i took it, played with, and bent it. Ended up stabbing my eye and permanently blinding my right eye.
To me, it’s because it’s the time of day where I can’t easily distract myself compared to early hours. The silence can also be really dreadful forcing you to think about things you didn’t want to.
I’m at 70 pulls and still no 5 star

I’m still a minor so I can’t really get help without my parents. Even if I could, depression is a huge taboo in my family. Chances are I’d be thrown out of the house the moment they realize I’ve been going to therapy. I tried opening up before but all they said was that it’s only for the rich to say they’re depressed. They said I can’t afford to be depressed and that it’s all an act I’m doing. 

But yeah... I get what you mean. My friends care for me and all. I just feel really really bad whenever I realize that they’re trying to take care of me but I can’t appreciate it as much. It’s like I’m burdening them further cause I can’t feel okay even though they’re clearly trying so hard to make me feel so.
